Vincent is an NPC in the  Artist's Abode. He serves as a guide to the Dye system, which was improved upon with his release.

Mechanics

[edit | edit source]

Dye Drop Chance Boost

[edit | edit source]

On every SkyBlock Year, 3 Dyes are randomly chosen by Vincent. Out of these, 2 have their drop chances doubled, while the 3rd one has its drop chances tripled during that year.

The current year's chosen Dyes can be seen in Vincent's interface.

Donating Dyes

[edit | edit source]

A Player can donate any non-animated Dye via Vincent's menu, thus converting it into a Bucket of Dye accessory of a matching color.

Garden

[edit | edit source]

Vincent can appear as a Visitor on  The Garden once the player reaches Garden 14 and donated a Dye to Vincent. Vincent requests  Sunflowers and has a 0.04% (1 in 2500) to award a  Wild Strawberry Dye.

Interface Bugs

[edit | edit source]
  • Opening the Dye Guide and sorting by Most Dropped will display the dyes in a seemingly random order. This is can be fixed by sorting the Dye Guide by Least Dropped and then going back to Most Dropped where it is then correctly displayed.

Dialogue

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
Below SkyBlock level 10
[NPC] Vincent: Hmm. I don't know if you've been here long enough to appreciate my artistry.
[NPC] Vincent: Maybe come back when you have SkyBlock Level 10!
Above SkyBlock level 10
[NPC] Vincent: Hello there. My name is Vincent.
[NPC] Vincent: I'm an artist. I believe you may be familiar with others, such as Marco and Pablo.
[NPC] Vincent: Let me ask you a question - have you ever heard of dyes?
Selecting [Yes...]
[NPC] Vincent: Very good, then I don't need to explain what they're used for.
[NPC] Vincent: However, I should probably give you some tips on how to get them...
[NPC] Vincent: As a painter, I prefer to use dyes as part of my work.
[NPC] Vincent: Dyes drop from a variety of different parts of SkyBlock and are extremely rare, so most artists just go with the flow and work with what they have.
[NPC] Vincent: However, I feel like I'm... different. Depending on what I'm painting, I need different types of dyes, but I always find exactly what I need!
[NPC] Vincent: It's almost as if the dyes I use become more common for everyone...
[NPC] Vincent: Nah, that would be CRAZY.
[NPC] Vincent: Anyways, if you ever want to see what I'm currently painting, come speak to me again!
Selecting [No, what are they?]
[NPC] Vincent: For someone like you, dyes can be used to turn any kind of armor a certain color.
[NPC] Vincent: You can apply them in an anvil alongside any piece of armor, and it will recolor it!
[NPC] Vincent: Though it's worth noting that this will consume the dye, meaning you won't get it back afterwards.
[NPC] Vincent: They don't call it a consumable for nothing!
[NPC] Vincent: As a painter, I prefer to use dyes as part of my work.
[NPC] Vincent: Dyes drop from a variety of different parts of SkyBlock and are extremely rare, so most artists just go with the flow and work with what they have.
[NPC] Vincent: However, I feel like I'm... different. Depending on what I'm painting, I need different types of dyes, but I always find exactly what I need!
[NPC] Vincent: It's almost as if the dyes I use become more common for everyone...
[NPC] Vincent: Nah, that would be CRAZY.
[NPC] Vincent: Anyways, if you ever want to see what I'm currently painting, come speak to me again!
Opening UI
[NPC] Vincent: Look! I can paint with all the colors of the rainbow!
[NPC] Vincent: I'm working on a masterpiece currently. Want to take a look?
[NPC] Vincent: This piece is really starting to shape up.
Unlocking Abiphone contact
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ Of all people in the village, you are the first to ask for my contact.
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ Truthfully, I have been a lonely man for as long as I can remember.
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ But, when I'm lonely, I make art, and it's great.
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ So, sometimes I worry, if I was to stop being lonely, what would happen to the quality of my art?
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ However, I suppose, while people are a bit much, a pet wouldn't hurt.
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ How about a Mole Pet? I've always found them to be positively adorable.
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ If you can bring me one, I'll give you my contact.
[GIVE ITEM]
Meeting Requirements
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ Ah, thank you! Look at his little nose - what a cute fella!
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ Inspiration has struck! I should paint him!
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ Here is my contact, now please leave me be for a while, for I must paint a masterpiece!
Not Meeting Requirements
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ You don't have a Mole Pet in your inventory. Are you some sort of scammer?
Calling the player, after the new year
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ Hello <player>! Vincent here! Happy new year!
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ I just wanted to let you know that I've had a strike of inspiration and have started working on my latest masterpiece!
[NPC] Vincent: ✆ Here are the dyes that I will be using throughout SkyBlock Year <year>!
Donating a dye bought from the Auction House on ♲ Ironman
[Ironman] You can only donate Dyes that you have dropped!
 The Garden None
[NPC] Vincent: I decided to take a leisurely stroll in search of inspiration, and as fate would have it - I ended up here!
Completing
[NPC] Vincent: These...these speak to me. There's something about them. You have inspired me once again!
Denying
[NPC] Vincent: If you truly love nature, you will find beauty everywhere. You, my friend, need to open your eyes.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • He explicitly mentions Marco and Pablo implying their fame.
  • 'Vincent is based on the 19th-century Dutch painter Vincent van Gogh, who is renowned worldwide for his works.
    • Similarly to his real life counterpart, Vincent is missing his left ear.
  • Vincent was added to the main server on the birthday of Andy Warhol, another famous artist, known particularly for his pop art.
  • Vincent asking for  Sunflower while visiting  The Garden is a reference to two series of still life paintings titled Sunflowers.
  • After giving Vincent a  Mole Pet for his Abiphone Contact, a [Lv53]  Mole Pet will be seen floating next to him.
    • Although the maximum rarity of a pet is MYTHIC, the pet's text color matches Vincent, but it may imply it is somehow DIVINE.
    • The level of Vincent's [Lv53]  Mole Pet, a reference to Vincent van Gogh being born in 1853.
  • ♲ Ironman players can only donate dyes that they have obtained themselves, and not ones purchased from the Auction House. This is tracked on a per-item basis, regardless of whether they have already obtained another copy of the same dye themselves.
